The '''''Shag Pabol''''' ('''[[Slavery/Legends|Slave]] Road''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]) was a vital [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that connected [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] was located on the route.<ref name="TEA" />
